name: MPCEval
description: MPCEval is a task-aware evaluation and benchmarking suite for multi-party conversation generation. It decomposes generation quality into speaker modeling, content quality, and speaker-content consistency, providing novel, quantitative, reference-free, and reproducible metrics that scale across datasets and models, addressing challenges unique to multi-party dialogue.
reputation: A very recent benchmark from the paper introducing MPCEval, with limited evidence of broad community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on multi-party conversation generation evaluation with metrics for speaker modeling, content quality, and speaker-content consistency; publicly available implementation.
